NARRATIVE AND PLANS
FOR THE PROPOSED MAP AMENDMENT
AT
2334-2336 SOUTH HOYNE AVENUE

The Application is to cause a Zoning Map Amendment for 2334-2336 South Hoyne Avenue from
RS-3 Residential Single Unit (Detached) District to B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed Use Unit District. The
Applicant proposes to construct a four-story, five (5) dwelling unit building. There will be three (3) parking
spaces. The footprint of the building shall be approximately 19 feet by 57 feet 2 inches in size, and the
building shall be 36 feet 7 inches high, as defined by City Code.

2334 SOUTH HOYNE

No changes are proposed to the existing three (3) dwelling Unit Building.
